description: Add a competitor app to one of your applications, identified by the competitor's store bundle ID. The competitor metadata is fetched from the store and ranking entries are backfilled for every keyword tracked on the main app.

app_id.description: The main application internal ID (from list_applications results)

competitor_app_id.description: Store bundle ID of the competitor (e.g. "com.spotify.music" for GPLAY, "284882215" or a bundle ID for ITUNES)

country.description: ISO country code (e.g., US, FR, DE)

lang.description: BCP-47 language-region code (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, de-DE)

store.description: App store: GPLAY (Google Play) or ITUNES (App Store)

name: add_competitor
